null_policy: preserve SQL null; require all logical keys

account_bindings.sql:
CREATE TABLE account_bindings (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_accounts(id),
 zenmoney_account_id TEXT NOT NULL, settings_version INTEGER, origin TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

account_capture_locks.sql:
CREATE TABLE account_capture_locks (
 account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES bank_accounts(id), job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES capture_jobs(id))

checks:
(selection='enabled' AND zenmoney_account_id IS NOT NULL AND import_start IS NOT NULL)
    OR (selection<>'enabled' AND zenmoney_account_id IS NULL)
bank_accounts.sql:
CREATE TABLE bank_accounts (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, bank TEXT NOT NULL, identity_scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(identity_scope IN ('bank','profile')),
 profile_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', source_key TEXT NOT NULL, currency TEXT NOT NULL,
 scale INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(scale BETWEEN 0 AND 12), label TEXT NOT NULL, masked_number TEXT NOT NULL,
 supported INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(supported IN (0,1)), unsupported_reason TEXT,
 selection TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unconfigured' CHECK(selection IN ('unconfigured','enabled','ignored')),
 zenmoney_account_id TEXT, import_start TEXT, settings_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(settings_version>=0),
 last_complete_end TEXT,
 CHECK((identity_scope='bank' AND profile_key='') OR (identity_scope='profile' AND profile_key<>'')),
 CHECK((selection='enabled' AND zenmoney_account_id IS NOT NULL AND import_start IS NOT NULL)
    OR (selection<>'enabled' AND zenmoney_account_id IS NULL)),
 UNIQUE(bank,identity_scope,profile_key,source_key,currency))

bank_aliases.sql:
CREATE TABLE bank_aliases (
 account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_accounts(id), external_id TEXT NOT NULL, identity_version TEXT NOT NULL,
 bank_id TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(account_id,external_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(bank_id,account_id) REFERENCES bank_transactions(id,account_id))

bank_exclusions.sql:
CREATE TABLE bank_exclusions (
 bank_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES bank_transactions(id), reason TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

bank_processing.sql:
CREATE TABLE bank_processing (
 bank_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES bank_transactions(id),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','prepared','uncertain','delivered','suppressed')),
 reason TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

triggers.name: processing_terminal_delete
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER processing_terminal_delete BEFORE DELETE ON bank_processing
 WHEN OLD.state IN ('delivered','suppressed')
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Processed bank operation cannot be deleted'); END

triggers.name: processing_terminal_update
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER processing_terminal_update BEFORE UPDATE OF state ON bank_processing
 WHEN (OLD.state='suppressed' AND NEW.state<>'suppressed')
   OR (OLD.state='delivered' AND NEW.state NOT IN ('delivered','suppressed'))
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Processed bank operation cannot be reset'); END

bank_transactions.sql:
CREATE TABLE bank_transactions (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_accounts(id), external_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 identity_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(identity_kind IN ('bank','fingerprint')), identity_version TEXT NOT NULL,
 local_date TEXT NOT NULL, occurred_at TEXT, direction TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(direction IN ('expense','income')),
 amount TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(money_valid(amount)), currency TEXT NOT NULL,
 description TEXT NOT NULL, beneficiary_account TEXT, beneficiary_name TEXT,
 raw_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(raw_json)), revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>=1),
 UNIQUE(account_id,external_id), UNIQUE(id,account_id))

triggers.name: bank_identity_immutable
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER bank_identity_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON bank_transactions
 WHEN NEW.id<>OLD.id OR NEW.account_id<>OLD.account_id OR NEW.external_id<>OLD.external_id
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Canonical bank identity is immutable'); END

bank_versions.sql:
CREATE TABLE bank_versions (
 bank_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_transactions(id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>=1),
 data_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(data_json)), raw_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(raw_json)),
 observed_at INTEGER NOT NULL, parser_version TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(bank_id,revision))

triggers.name: bank_version_immutable
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER bank_version_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON bank_versions
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Bank revision history is append-only'); END

triggers.name: bank_version_preserved
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER bank_version_preserved BEFORE DELETE ON bank_versions
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Bank revision history is append-only'); END

capture_errors.sql:
CREATE TABLE capture_errors (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES capture_jobs(id), account_id TEXT REFERENCES bank_accounts(id),
 code TEXT NOT NULL, retryable INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(retryable IN (0,1)), resolved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(resolved IN (0,1)),
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

capture_intervals.sql:
CREATE TABLE capture_intervals (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES capture_jobs(id),
 account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_accounts(id), settings_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 start_date TEXT NOT NULL, end_date TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL,
 total_pages INTEGER, total_records INTEGER, CHECK(start_date<=end_date))

triggers.name: interval_identity
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER interval_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON capture_intervals
 WHEN NEW.id<>OLD.id OR NEW.job_id<>OLD.job_id OR NEW.account_id<>OLD.account_id
 OR NEW.settings_version<>OLD.settings_version OR NEW.start_date<>OLD.start_date OR NEW.end_date<>OLD.end_date
 OR (OLD.state='complete' AND (NEW.state<>'complete' OR NEW.total_pages IS NOT OLD.total_pages OR NEW.total_records IS NOT OLD.total_records))
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Capture interval identity and completion evidence are immutable'); END

triggers.name: interval_scope
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER interval_scope BEFORE INSERT ON capture_intervals
 WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job_accounts WHERE job_id=NEW.job_id AND account_id=NEW.account_id AND settings_version=NEW.settings_version)
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Interval must belong to a job account snapshot'); END

indexes.name: one_active_capture
indexes.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_active_capture ON capture_jobs(connection_id)
 WHERE capture_state IN ('planned','collecting','paused')

capture_jobs.sql:
CREATE TABLE capture_jobs (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, connection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES connections(id),
 request_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, request_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(request_json)),
 end_date TEXT NOT NULL, capture_state TEXT NOT NULL, delivery_state TEXT NOT NULL,
 worker_id TEXT, lease_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, lease_expires_at INTEGER,
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

capture_pages.sql:
CREATE TABLE capture_pages (
 interval_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES capture_intervals(id), page_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(page_number>=1),
 digest TEXT NOT NULL, records_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(records_count>=0),
 payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload_json)), PRIMARY KEY(interval_id,page_number))

triggers.name: page_immutable
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER page_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON capture_pages
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Acknowledged pages are append-only'); END

triggers.name: page_preserved
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER page_preserved BEFORE DELETE ON capture_pages
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Acknowledged pages are append-only'); END

captured_records.sql:
CREATE TABLE captured_records (
 interval_id TEXT NOT NULL, page_number INTEGER NOT NULL, bank_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(interval_id,bank_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(interval_id,page_number) REFERENCES capture_pages(interval_id,page_number),
 FOREIGN KEY(bank_id,revision) REFERENCES bank_versions(bank_id,revision))

triggers.name: captured_record_immutable
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER captured_record_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON captured_records
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Captured revisions are append-only'); END

triggers.name: captured_record_preserved
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER captured_record_preserved BEFORE DELETE ON captured_records
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Captured revisions are append-only'); END

triggers.name: captured_record_scope
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER captured_record_scope BEFORE INSERT ON captured_records
 WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capture_intervals i JOIN bank_transactions b ON b.id=NEW.bank_id
                  WHERE i.id=NEW.interval_id AND i.account_id=b.account_id)
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Captured record must belong to interval account'); END

category_choices.sql:
CREATE TABLE category_choices (
 bank_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES bank_transactions(id), category_id TEXT, source TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

category_evidence.sql:
CREATE TABLE category_evidence (
 bank_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_transactions(id), zen_id TEXT NOT NULL, category_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 direction TEXT NOT NULL, origin TEXT NOT NULL, eligible INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(eligible IN (0,1)),
 PRIMARY KEY(bank_id,zen_id,category_id))

category_payments.sql:
CREATE TABLE category_payments (
 bank_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES bank_transactions(id), category_id TEXT,
 reason TEXT NOT NULL, eligible INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(eligible IN (0,1)),
 zen_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(zen_ids_json)))

category_predictions.sql:
CREATE TABLE category_predictions (
 bank_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, bank_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, category_id TEXT,
 source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source IN ('manual','rule','history','unknown')), reason TEXT NOT NULL,
 candidates_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(candidates_json)), mirror_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 FOREIGN KEY(bank_id,bank_revision) REFERENCES bank_versions(bank_id,revision))

connection_accounts.sql:
CREATE TABLE connection_accounts (
 connection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES connections(id), account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_accounts(id),
 PRIMARY KEY(connection_id,account_id))

connection_discovery.sql:
CREATE TABLE connection_discovery (
 connection_id TEXT NOT NULL, account_id TEXT NOT NULL, present INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(present IN (0,1)),
 supported INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(supported IN (0,1)), unsupported_reason TEXT, label TEXT NOT NULL, masked_number TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(connection_id,account_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(connection_id,account_id) REFERENCES connection_accounts(connection_id,account_id))

connection_labels.sql:
CREATE TABLE connection_labels (
 connection_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES connections(id),
 label TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(label)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120))

connections.sql:
CREATE TABLE connections (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, bank TEXT NOT NULL, profile_key TEXT NOT NULL,
 profile_identity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(profile_identity IN ('bank','user_selected')),
 connector_version TEXT NOT NULL, timezone TEXT,
 capabilities_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(capabilities_json)),
 accounts_complete INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(accounts_complete IN (0,1)),
 UNIQUE(bank,profile_key))

coverage.sql:
CREATE TABLE coverage (
 account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_accounts(id), start_date TEXT NOT NULL, end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
 interval_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES capture_intervals(id), CHECK(start_date<=end_date),
 PRIMARY KEY(account_id,start_date,end_date,interval_id))

deliveries.sql:
CREATE TABLE deliveries (
 bank_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES bank_transactions(id), zen_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload)), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('prepared','attempting','uncertain','delivered','suppressed')),
 ever_attempted INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ever_attempted IN (0,1)), origin TEXT NOT NULL,
 authorized_job_id TEXT REFERENCES capture_jobs(id), updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 needs_rebuild INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(needs_rebuild IN (0,1)),
 CHECK(state<>'attempting' OR (ever_attempted=1 AND needs_rebuild=0)))

triggers.name: delivery_immutable
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER delivery_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON deliveries
 WHEN NEW.zen_id<>OLD.zen_id OR NEW.bank_id<>OLD.bank_id OR NEW.ever_attempted<OLD.ever_attempted
   OR (OLD.ever_attempted=1 AND NEW.payload<>OLD.payload)
   OR (OLD.state='suppressed' AND NEW.state<>'suppressed')
   OR (OLD.state='delivered' AND NEW.state NOT IN ('delivered','suppressed'))
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Delivery identity or attempted payload is immutable'); END

triggers.name: delivery_preserved
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER delivery_preserved BEFORE DELETE ON deliveries
 WHEN OLD.ever_attempted=1 OR OLD.state IN ('delivered','suppressed')
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Attempted delivery cannot be deleted'); END

delivery_attempts.sql:
CREATE TABLE delivery_attempts (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, bank_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_transactions(id), zen_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 at INTEGER NOT NULL, outcome TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload)))

triggers.name: attempt_immutable
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER attempt_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON delivery_attempts
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Delivery attempts are append-only'); END

triggers.name: attempt_preserved
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER attempt_preserved BEFORE DELETE ON delivery_attempts
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Delivery attempts are append-only'); END

delivery_authorizations.sql:
CREATE TABLE delivery_authorizations (
 bank_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES bank_transactions(id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
 job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES capture_jobs(id), interval_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 settings_version INTEGER NOT NULL, target_id TEXT NOT NULL, source_hash TEXT,
 authorized_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 FOREIGN KEY(bank_id,revision) REFERENCES bank_versions(bank_id,revision),
 FOREIGN KEY(interval_id,bank_id) REFERENCES captured_records(interval_id,bank_id))

triggers.name: delivery_authorization_frozen
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER delivery_authorization_frozen BEFORE UPDATE ON delivery_authorizations
 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM deliveries d WHERE d.bank_id=OLD.bank_id AND d.ever_attempted=1)
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Attempted delivery authorization is immutable'); END

triggers.name: delivery_authorization_preserved
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER delivery_authorization_preserved BEFORE DELETE ON delivery_authorizations
 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM deliveries d WHERE d.bank_id=OLD.bank_id AND d.ever_attempted=1)
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Attempted delivery authorization cannot be deleted'); END

triggers.name: delivery_authorization_proof
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER delivery_authorization_proof BEFORE INSERT ON delivery_authorizations
 WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM captured_records r JOIN capture_intervals i ON i.id=r.interval_id
   JOIN bank_transactions b ON b.id=r.bank_id JOIN job_accounts a ON a.job_id=NEW.job_id AND a.account_id=b.account_id
   WHERE r.interval_id=NEW.interval_id AND r.bank_id=NEW.bank_id AND r.revision=NEW.revision AND i.state='complete'
     AND a.settings_version=NEW.settings_version AND a.target_id=NEW.target_id)
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Delivery needs completed capture and job authorization'); END

triggers.name: delivery_authorization_update_proof
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER delivery_authorization_update_proof BEFORE UPDATE ON delivery_authorizations
 WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM captured_records r JOIN capture_intervals i ON i.id=r.interval_id
   JOIN bank_transactions b ON b.id=r.bank_id JOIN job_accounts a ON a.job_id=NEW.job_id AND a.account_id=b.account_id
   WHERE r.interval_id=NEW.interval_id AND r.bank_id=NEW.bank_id AND r.revision=NEW.revision AND i.state='complete'
     AND a.settings_version=NEW.settings_version AND a.target_id=NEW.target_id)
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Delivery needs completed capture and job authorization'); END

delivery_schedule.sql:
CREATE TABLE delivery_schedule (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), next_run_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(failures>=0))

job_accounts.sql:

 PRIMARY KEY(job_id,account_id))

triggers.name: job_account_snapshot
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER job_account_snapshot BEFORE UPDATE ON job_accounts
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Job account settings snapshot is immutable'); END

job_context.sql:
CREATE TABLE job_context (

triggers.name: job_context_snapshot
triggers.sql:

job_requests.sql:

triggers.name: request_immutable

triggers.name: request_preserved

legacy_imports.sql:

 digest TEXT PRIMARY KEY, imported_at INTEGER NOT NULL, source_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(manifest_json)), report_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(report_json)))

legacy_objects.sql:

legacy_rows.sql:

link_bank_members.sql:

link_groups.sql:

link_zen_members.sql:

triggers.name: receipt_immutable
triggers.sql:

triggers.name: receipt_preserved

processing_targets.sql:

triggers.name: processing_target_immutable

triggers.name: processing_target_preserved

recipient_rules.sql:

reimport_ranges.sql:

schema_migrations.sql:

 version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, applied_at INTEGER NOT NULL, backup_path TEXT)

service_meta.sql: CREATE TABLE service_meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

zen_deletions.sql:

zen_entities.sql:

zen_exclusions.sql: CREATE TABLE zen_exclusions (zen_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

zen_mirror_state.sql:

zen_movements.sql:

zen_sync_runs.sql:
CREATE TABLE zen_sync_runs (

zen_tags.sql:
CREATE TABLE zen_tags (

zen_tombstones.sql:

triggers.name: tombstone_identity
triggers.sql:

triggers.name: tombstone_preserved

 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Remote deletion history is permanent'); END
